From Internet Archive scans the program selects pages with graphics

From Internet Archive scans the program selects pages with graphics: in the layout of the OCR text it looks for plates and gaps in the type, in the page image for a connected graphic area. Landscape plates are rotated to the orientation in which the caption reads most confidently. The caption is the lines below the image; the illustration is linked to a library paragraph by matching the text of neighbouring pages. For Project Gutenberg books the images and typeset captions are taken directly from the HTML edition, and scans of whole plates are split into separate pictures. Captions are checked and translated, and type, peoples and places are refined; the region is derived from the places in the caption or, if there are none, provisionally from the adjacent paragraph. Corrections are made in the team workspace. Scripts #a_illustrations.py, #c_illustrations_gutenberg.py and #b_illustrations_site.py
